## Verification

List checks actually run, their results, and material checks not performed.

## Before merge

- [ ] Coordinator reviewed the current revision; blocking findings are resolved.
- [ ] Required checks pass; any changes after review were rechecked.
- [ ] No credentials, private notes, generated output or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Merge targets `main`; deployment, access changes and dependency installation have applicable authorization.

PR authors do not approve their own work. The Coordinator records local review and merges the reviewed head SHA; no GitHub AI review action is required.
